facility.name: ABC Children's Learning Center
facility.programs_provided: School Age Care,Before School Care,Meals Provided ,After School Care,Snacks Provided,Transportation to/from School ,Field Trips

provenance.note: Census Geocoder Exact match: 8385 ANTOINE DR, HOUSTON, TX, 77088

inspection_summary.note: Texas HHSC inspections, report investigations and assessments since October 2017, updated daily.

occurrences.finding: Animals - Do Not Create Unsafe or Unsanitary Conditions: CCR observed three goats loose and feces on the ground in the area where they are housed on the side of the operation, the same area also serves as an emergency exit route for children.
occurrences.violation_type_title: Animals - Do Not Create Unsafe or Unsanitary Conditions (26 TAC §746.3901(2))

occurrences.finding: Animals at Center - Statement of Health from Veterinarian: The operation has goats, a rooster, and chickens on the premises. During the inspection, no documentation of health statements from a veterinarian was provided.
occurrences.violation_type_title: Animals at Center - Statement of Health from Veterinarian (26 TAC §746.3903(b))

occurrences.finding: Required Records Maintained and Made Available - Employees' Attendance: The directors have not been documenting their attendance, and records were unavailable during the inspection.
occurrences.violation_type_title: Required Records Maintained and Made Available - Employees' Attendance (26 TAC §746.801(5))

occurrences.finding: Documented Annual Training- Required Content: CCR reviewed two caregiver files and found that the required training on understanding building and physical premises safety was missing. Additionally, the Pre-K teacher was missing all the required special safety topics training.
occurrences.violation_type_title: Documented Annual Training- Required Content (26 TAC §746.1309(e))

occurrences.finding: Director Annual Training - Additional required topics: CCR reviewed the directors' files and observed that the director/owner and the second director is missing the required training on understanding building and physical premises safety.
occurrences.violation_type_title: Director Annual Training - Additional required topics (26 TAC §746.1311(e))

occurrences.finding: Required Admission Information - Special Needs Statement: CCR reviewed a child s admission form and observed that it was missing a statement regarding the child's special care needs.  Correction: CCR reviewed the standards with the director and emphasized the importance of having parents document any special care needs or treatments for their child. Additionally, the child is no longer enrolled.
occurrences.violation_type_title: Required Admission Information - Special Needs Statement (26 TAC §746.605(12))

occurrences.finding: Report Number of Employees: A review of the Employees Who Left Employment in 2025 data from January 20, 2026, revealed that the center had not reported the number of employees who left employment in 2025 by January 15, 2026, as required.
occurrences.violation_type_title: Report Number of Employees (26 TAC §746.303(b))

occurrences.finding: Caregivers Must Wear Gloves When Handling Blood or Bodily Fluids: Video footage reveals caregivers not wearing gloves while handling blood after a child's injury.
occurrences.violation_type_title: Caregivers Must Wear Gloves When Handling Blood or Bodily Fluids (26 TAC §746.3425(1))

occurrences.finding: Requirements for Feeding Infants - Other Use of Handwashing Sink: It was determined that a caregiver had used the handwashing sink located near the diaper-changing table in the infant's room to clean a child's wound after an injury. The infant's caregiver also used this sink to clean the infant's bottle and wash their hands.
occurrences.violation_type_title: Requirements for Feeding Infants - Other Use of Handwashing Sink (26 TAC §746.2419(8))

occurrences.finding: Employee Handwashing After Handling or Cleaning Bodily Fluids: A caregiver failed to wash their hands with soap and water after cleaning a child's blood from an injury.
occurrences.violation_type_title: Employee Handwashing After Handling or Cleaning Bodily Fluids (26 TAC §746.3415(7))

occurrences.finding: Measurement of Use Zone for Stationary Equipment: Video footage obtained during the investigation shows stationary equipment located less than six feet away from the fence on the toddlers playground.
occurrences.violation_type_title: Measurement of Use Zone for Stationary Equipment (26 TAC §746.4803)

occurrences.finding: Maintenance of Building, Grounds and Equipment: On the toddler playground, CCR observed an unsecured utility box that protects the ground utility lines. The box was not secured to the ground. The operation attempted to use a crawl-through tunnel to cover the utility box, but because of the tunnel s openings, it does not prevent children from accessing the underground utility lines.
occurrences.violation_type_title: Maintenance of Building, Grounds and Equipment (26 TAC §746.3407)

occurrences.finding: Report Number of Employees: A review of the Employees Who Left Employment in 2023 data from January 17, 2025, revealed that the center had not reported the number of employees who left employment in 2024 by January 15, 2025, as required.
occurrences.violation_type_title: Report Number of Employees (26 TAC §746.303(b))

occurrences.finding: Child/Caregiver Ratio - 18 Months Difference in Age: A caregiver had 16 children in her group ages from 1 month old child and the oldest was 5 years old. The oldest child was older than 18 months from the yongest child in care.
occurrences.violation_type_title: Child/Caregiver Ratio - 18 Months Difference in Age (26 TAC §746.1605(1))

occurrences.finding: Child/ Caregiver Ratio - 13 or More Children: A caregiver had 16 children, in the breakfast room, specified age group was 3 years old. The caregiver was one over required ratio.         Corrected:  When a caregiver arrived and took a group of children with her to a classroom next door.
occurrences.violation_type_title: Child/ Caregiver Ratio - 13 or More Children (26 TAC §746.1601)

occurrences.finding: Supervision ensures each child?s safety, well-being, including physical proximity and auditory or visual awareness of each child?s on going activity: A child was left alone in the restroom while caregiver attended to other children in the classroom area, the restroom used was not in the classroom but next door to the classroom
occurrences.violation_type_title: Supervision ensures each child?s safety, well-being, including physical proximity and auditory or visual awareness of each child?s on going activity (26 TAC §746.1205(a)(4))

occurrences.finding: Infant May Not Sleep in a Restrictive Device: A one month old infant was sleeping in a car seat.             Corrected:  When caregiver took the infant out of the car seat.
occurrences.violation_type_title: Infant May Not Sleep in a Restrictive Device (26 TAC §746.2426(a)(1))

occurrences.finding: Installation and Maintenance of Loose-fill Surfacing - Six Inches if Equipment 5 Ft or Less: The outdoor play area was not covered with at least 6 inches of mulch.
occurrences.violation_type_title: Installation and Maintenance of Loose-fill Surfacing - Six Inches if Equipment 5 Ft or Less (26 TAC §746.4907(a)(1))

occurrences.finding: Child/ Caregiver Ratio - 13 or More Children: There were six children, ages 9 months to 23 months with one caregiver. The specified age group was 12-17 months old. With this specified age group, one caregiver can care for five children. This was corrected at inspection when the oldest child was moved to another classroom.
occurrences.violation_type_title: Child/ Caregiver Ratio - 13 or More Children (26 TAC §746.1601)

occurrences.finding: Screen Time Activities - Not Used During Eating or Rest Times: The television was being watched by children during breakfast time.
occurrences.violation_type_title: Screen Time Activities - Not Used During Eating or Rest Times (26 TAC §746.2207(c)(4))

occurrences.finding: Training Requirements for Employees and Caregivers - Pre-service Training: A follow-up inspection was conducted and compliance was not met. This deficiency is being re-cited.  The caregiver is lacking 8 clock hours of pre-service training.
occurrences.violation_type_title: Training Requirements for Employees and Caregivers - Pre-service Training (26 TAC §746.1301(2)(A))

occurrences.finding: Responsibilities of Caregivers - Know Children's Names and Ages: A caregiver did not know the ages of the children she was responsible for.
occurrences.violation_type_title: Responsibilities of Caregivers - Know Children's Names and Ages (26 TAC §746.1203(3))

occurrences.finding: Electronic Child Safety Alarm - is equipped in each vehicle: A follow-up inspection was conducted and compliance was not met. This deficiency is being re-cited. The required electronic child safety alarm has not been installed.
occurrences.violation_type_title: Electronic Child Safety Alarm - is equipped in each vehicle (26 TAC §746.5625(a))

occurrences.finding: Child/Caregiver Ratio - 18 Months Difference in Age: A 9 month old infant was in a classroom with a 3 year old child. Infants can't be combined with children that are more than 18 months older than the youngest child in the group. This was corrected at inspection.
occurrences.violation_type_title: Child/Caregiver Ratio - 18 Months Difference in Age (26 TAC §746.1605)

occurrences.finding: Required Immunizations: Of the 10 children's records evalujated, four are behind with required immunizations.
occurrences.violation_type_title: Required Immunizations (26 TAC §746.613(a))

occurrences.finding: Training Requirements for Employees and Caregivers - Pre-service Training: Of the 10 staff records evaluated, one caregiver did not complete the required 24 clock hours of required pre-service training.
occurrences.violation_type_title: Training Requirements for Employees and Caregivers - Pre-service Training (26 TAC §746.1301(2)(A))

occurrences.finding: Director Annual Training 30 Hours Required: The director did not receive 30 clock hours of training in all of the required topics for their respective training years. Make-up hours will need to be completed that will not count towards the current training year.
occurrences.violation_type_title: Director Annual Training 30 Hours Required (26 TAC §746.1311(a))

occurrences.finding: Additional Minimum Qualifications for Caregivers - HS Diploma, Equivalent, Certification of Completion: A person that has been working as a caregiver does not have a high diploma or GED; therefore, they do not meet caregiver qualifications.
occurrences.violation_type_title: Additional Minimum Qualifications for Caregivers - HS Diploma, Equivalent, Certification of Completion (26 TAC §746.1107(2))

occurrences.finding: Required Personnel Records- Photo Identification: Of the 10 personnel records evaluated, two lacked photo identification.
occurrences.violation_type_title: Required Personnel Records- Photo Identification (26 TAC §746.901(8))

occurrences.finding: Documented Annual Training Area - 24 Hours Required: Of the 10 personnel records evaluated, caregivers did not receive 24 clock hours of training in the required topics. The caregivers will need to complete make-up training hours that will not count towards the current training year.
occurrences.violation_type_title: Documented Annual Training Area - 24 Hours Required (26 TAC §746.1309(a))

occurrences.finding: Required Admission Information - Emergency Medical Authorization: Of the 10 children's records evaluated, one lacked authorization for emergency medical care.
occurrences.violation_type_title: Required Admission Information - Special Needs Statement (26 TAC §746.605(12))

occurrences.finding: Required Health Statement - Written, dated within past year, indicates child is physically able to participate in operation's child-care program: Of the 10 personnel records evaluated, one lacked a health statement from a health care professional.
occurrences.violation_type_title: Required Health Statement - Written, dated within past year, indicates child is physically able to participate in operation's child-care program (26 TAC §746.611(a)(1))

occurrences.finding: Medication Records - Date, Time and Amount Given: The amount of medication given and the time was not documented on the medication log for several days in August 2022 and September 2022. This was corrected at inspection.
occurrences.violation_type_title: Medication Records - Date, Time and Amount Given (26 TAC §746.3805(c)(3))

occurrences.finding: Training Requirements for Employees, Caregivers, and Directors - Transportation Training: One van driver and one of the directors has not completed a transportation safety course.
occurrences.violation_type_title: Training Requirements for Employees, Caregivers, and Directors - Transportation Training (26 TAC §746.1301(7)(A))

occurrences.finding: Written Operational Policies - Promotion of Physical Activity: The parent handbook does not inform parents of the requirement for physicaal activity and outdoor activity.
occurrences.violation_type_title: Written Operational Policies - Promotion of Physical Activity (26 TAC §746.501(a)(18))

occurrences.finding: Required Equipment in Vehicles - First-aid Kit: One van was not equipped with a First Aid Kit. This was corrected at inspection.
occurrences.violation_type_title: Required Equipment in Vehicles - First-aid Kit (26 TAC §746.5617(a)(6))

occurrences.finding: Required Personnel Records - Required Affidavit: Of the 10 staff records evaluated, one lacked a notarized affidavit,
occurrences.violation_type_title: Required Personnel Records - Required Affidavit (Form 2985) (26 TAC §746.901(4))

occurrences.finding: Written Operational Policies - Vaccine Preventable Diseases: The parent handbook does not inform parents of the vaccination requirements for staff.
occurrences.violation_type_title: Written Operational Policies - Vaccine Preventable Diseases (26 TAC §746.501(a)(28))

occurrences.finding: Written Operational Policies - Emergency Preparedness Plans: The emergency preparedness plan is lacking the following information:  1.  How children under 2 and with limited mobility will be evacuated.  2. How children will be cared for during the emergency.  3. How children will be reunited with their parents.
occurrences.violation_type_title: Written Operational Policies - Emergency Preparedness Plans (26 TAC §746.501(a)(24))

occurrences.finding: Screen Time Activities - Not Used for Under Two: Children under the age of 2 were watching television. This was corrected at inspection.
occurrences.violation_type_title: Screen Time Activities - Not Used for Under Two (26 TAC §746.2207(a))

occurrences.finding: Required Admission Information - School Information for School-age Child: Of the 10 children's records evaluated, two acked the name and address of the school the children attend.
occurrences.violation_type_title: Required Admission Information - School Information for School-age Child (26 TAC §746.605(14))

occurrences.finding: Electronic Child Safety Alarm - is equipped in each vehicle: Two vans used to transport children are not equipped with the required electronic child safety alarm.
occurrences.violation_type_title: Electronic Child Safety Alarm - is equipped in each vehicle (26 TAC §746.5625(a))

occurrences.finding: Annual Fire Inspection - Before Initial Permit Issued and Every 12 Months: During the follow up inspection, the fire inspection had expired on 11/11/21.
occurrences.violation_type_title: Annual Fire Inspection - Before Initial Permit Issued and Every 12 Months (26 TAC §746.5101(a))
